subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts an antique brass key complete with ornate bow, shaft, bit, and an attached red tassel.

category.why: The key floats isolated in three-quarter view over a single saturated background featuring a gradient and a pattern of keyhole motifs.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The object is well-centred with comfortable, even margins around all edges.

colour.why: The vibrant green background contrasts cleanly with the rich gold brass and bright red tassel.

detail.why: The shapes are chunky and simplified with no extraneous micro-details, scratches, or busy textures.

style.why: The smooth, softly shaded 3D volumes and satin finish perfectly match the reference cards.

bg_colour.why: background is green (100% of the background); planned green
